components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Use for the one committed action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.540 0.145 330); color: oklch(1.000 0.000 0); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.430 0.130 330); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.880 0.105 86); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Use for secondary screen actions and inline controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: oklch(0.985 0.004 250); color: oklch(0.180 0.018 250); border: 1px solid oklch(0.875 0.010 250); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.972 0.006 250); border-color: oklch(0.720 0.018 250); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.540 0.145 330); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Evidence Chip
components.description: Use for measured parser, deletion, simulation, and review states.
components.css: .ds-chip-warning { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; background: oklch(0.955 0.040 82); color: oklch(0.180 0.018 250); border: 1px solid oklch(0.820 0.130 82); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Risk Input
components.description: Use for filters, parser-rule fields, and settings forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: oklch(0.180 0.018 250); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; background: oklch(1.000 0.000 0); color: oklch(0.180 0.018 250); border: 1px solid oklch(0.875 0.010 250); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.55 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.540 0.145 330); outline: 2px solid oklch(0.890 0.070 330); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Use in the dark app sidebar for primary views.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: oklch(0.620 0.030 250); text-decoration: none; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.220 0.012 250); color: oklch(1.000 0.000 0); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: oklch(0.240 0.040 330); color: oklch(1.000 0.000 0); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.880 0.105 86); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Skeleton Row
components.description: Use for table loading states instead of centered spinners.
components.css: .ds-skeleton-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 0.7fr; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.875 0.010 250); background: oklch(1.000 0.000 0); } .ds-skeleton-row span { height: 12px; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.940 0.006 250), oklch(0.985 0.004 250), oklch(0.940 0.006 250)); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: ds-skeleton 1.2s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-skeleton { from { background-position: 100% 0; } to { background-position: -100% 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skeleton-row span { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: A restrained product interface for reviewing evidence. It uses light dense content surfaces, a dark navigation anchor, sparse rose identity, and semantic state colors for measured evidence.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red, and blue appear only when they encode measured state, warning, risk, or traceability.

rules.name: The Rose Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Ledger Rose is identity, not decoration. It marks the current action or selected object.

rules.name: The Data First Rule
rules.body: Numbers, ids, and trace references use mono; prose and controls use Inter.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, tables, and score panels use borders and tonal backgrounds at rest.

dos: Do use White Ledger as the default content background.
Do reserve Ledger Rose for primary action, selection, and focus.
Do use Signal Green, Evidence Amber, Risk Red, and Trace Blue only for measured states.
Do keep score inputs traceable to raw evidence, parser output, simulation, or deletion records.
Do preserve WCAG AA contrast for every label, chip, table cell, and placeholder.
donts: Don't look like a hype-driven trading bot, exchange casino, or profit-promise funnel.
Don't imply guaranteed returns, investment advice, or autonomous live execution.
Don't hide score inputs behind black-box summaries.
Don't treat subscribers, views, forwards, or reactions as quality claims without labeling them as proxies.
Don't use decorative dashboard chrome that competes with evidence, tables, traces, and audit trails.
